pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, medium-tan polygonal regions. Edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients with low angularity and rounded vertices. Individual patches occupy roughly 75-80% of the visible spatial area relative to the light background.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial (Y-shaped) and occasional quadri-radial (X-shaped) intersections. Pathway thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the mid-flank, thinning slightly toward the upper neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck ridge presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. Individual fiber clusters create a fuzzy, jagged 1D geometric contour against the blurred background.
